lines.speaker: Sender
lines.text: I have bad news for you. A few months ago I gained access to your devices and have been monitoring you.

lines.speaker: Sender
lines.text: I recorded you through your webcam and saved everything. I also have your contacts and your password.

lines.speaker: Sender
lines.text: If you don't want me to send the video to your family and coworkers, you must pay.

lines.speaker: Sender
lines.text: Send $1,500 in Bitcoin to the wallet below within 48 hours. The timer has already started.

lines.speaker: Sender
lines.text: Do not reply, do not tell anyone, and do not contact the police. I will know if you do, and I will release everything immediately.
